title: SkillGraft
description: The visible attachment of a chosen skill to an Agent Node before or during a run (binder README Seamanship, ch09 skill_grafts). Every navigated node names its grafted seamanship on the team proposal and the Work Receipt. Grafts are auditable facts with a reason and an outcome, not silent prompt injection.

level.description: Graft depth per ch09: light mention, reference file load, full SKILL.md, tool-backed, or team-wide.

reason.description: Why the planner or agent chose this skill for this node.

grantedBy.description: Planner, operator, or staff agent that approved the graft.

sourceEventId.description: The skill_graft transcript event recording this graft.
